text: 2. I got completely lost in the one-way system. I was going round in circles for ages. Then I must have taken the wrong turning, and I ended up on the motorway going out of town. Haven't you got a GPS? No. I did consider getting one at one point, but I decided it wasn't worth it. I just don't drive that much. They're not that expensive. They've come down in price a lot, you know, and they're very straightforward, very easy to use. Right, but even so, I think I can do without one. But think of the time you'd save. Well, today, maybe. But don't you worry about all those satellites tracking you all the time. Now you're just being paranoid.
